variants.about_this_item:
• for dogs, cats and other small animals
  • with nurturing cleaning lotion (aloe vera and hamamelis)
  • pull over your finger and free the ears of dirt and contamination

Ear care for your pet Clean ears are a must for all pets - but caring for them can be uncomfortable for our pets. Our disposable ear care pads are gentle and easy to use. You can simply slip the pads over your fingers and gently clean your pet's ear. The nourishing cleansing lotion made of aloe vera and witch hazel supports the ear hygiene and cares for the sensitive skin.
